hook: You won't believe when VisionQuest actually happens because Terry Matalas just flipped the whole MCU timeline.

sections.voiceover: You won't believe when VisionQuest actually happens because Terry Matalas just flipped the whole MCU timeline.
b_roll: Portrait of Paul Bettany in character

sections.voiceover: Paul Bettany previously expected the show to take place in 2024. Fans assumed that date matched the broader Marvel chronology. Where does the super-powered robot actually fit?
b_roll: Clip of the robot from Avengers: Age of Ultron

sections.voiceover: Terry Matalas revealed a completely different position for the WandaVision spin-off.
Avengers: Age of Ultron introduced the character back in 2015. Terry Matalas revealed a timeline position that contradicts the earlier 2024 expectation.
The 2015 debut origin defines the updated chronology.
b_roll: Final close-up of Vision in Avengers: Age of Ultron
